description: This file defines a Bluetooth driver class for Broadcom BCM43XX chips, including configuration, initialization, firmware loading, and reset functionalities. It also provides C linkage functions for constructing and destructing the driver instance.

classes.name: Broadcom43XX
classes.description: A driver class for Broadcom BCM43XX Bluetooth chips, handling configuration, firmware loading, reset, and initialization.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Broadcom43XX driver, including port, firmware path, baud rate, MAC address, and flags.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bluetooth chip, resets it, loads firmware, sets MAC address, and configures the driver mode.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Sends a reset command to the Bluetooth chip.

methods.name: LoadName
methods.description: Reads the local name of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: SetClock
methods.description: Sets the clock speed of the chip.

methods.name: SetSpeed
methods.description: Configures the baud rate of the serial connection.

methods.name: MACAddress
methods.description: Sets the MAC address of the Bluetooth device.

methods.name: Firmware
methods.description: Loads firmware into the Bluetooth chip from specified directory.

methods.name: FindFirmware
methods.description: Recursively searches for firmware files matching the chip name.
